Local packaging compatibility patch: blivedm 1.1.7+vtuber.1

Upstream: https://github.com/xfgryujk/blivedm
Commit: 3bf17fe862b8c2fc6bc04c81c3f0c5db95de93d6
License: MIT (LICENSE retained).
upstream.json records the downloaded archive and original file SHA-256 hashes.

All Python source files are unmodified upstream files. Only pyproject.toml
changes the distribution version and dependency ranges:
  aiohttp: ~=3.9.0 -> >=3.14.1,<3.15
  Brotli:  ~=1.1.0 -> >=1.2.0,<1.3
  yarl:    ~=1.9.3 -> >=1.24.2,<1.25
pure-protobuf keeps the upstream range.

This avoids downgrading the shared application's existing HTTP stack merely
to satisfy old upstream metadata. The narrow ranges cover the locally tested
minor versions; widening them requires running tests/test_bilibili_transport.py
and the full application suite. Tests cover local WebSocket lifecycle,
compressed packet decoding, URL/cookie handling and account identity delivery.
They do not establish live Bilibili availability or account authentication.

Install from the repository root:
  .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m pip install -r requirements-bilibili.txt

Do not edit installed dist-info metadata or install the unrelated PyPI package.
